theShortfallTest.resolution: Resolved at source rather than by reading the join's prose. doctor-actor-leftover-join.v6 is the live DR-114 row ledger, is pinned here and reproduces, and its summary.leftoverDesign is exactly those eight. Its own roster carries OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC at leftoverDesign false with rideStanding qualification-at-named-gate, because a G12 specification now exists. I ruled then that the live ledger is the current side and the harness list the stale one. Ruling the same way here is the same rule applied to the reciprocal case, not a convenience.
theShortfallTest.andTheProhibitionAgrees: The dispatch forbids taking over G12. Omitting OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC from a not-stolen list, while refusing G12 by name in the same reason and again in doesNot, is the handling that obeys both the ledger and the prohibition. Carrying it would have been the breach.

coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty-eight attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: subject 234daa83 at 0444, 18041 bytes, unmoved; HEAD never left 5d5d778 and recordedInputs.HEAD equals the top-level head as the remeasurementClause requires; required-now 26 of 26; file 08 and COORD unmodified and both matching their recorded pins. All thirteen recordedInputs files reproduce, and I cross-checked every basedOn path and review path against that table — zero disagreements, which matters because a join carries its custody twice and a divergence would be invisible to a check of either surface alone. The one attack that needed real work is the inventory-shortfall test, the shape that produced my only blocker in this family. G21 v3's whatThisCloses.leftoverDesignRemainingOnDR114 enumerates nine; this join's OBL-DR114-LEFTOVER-NOT-STOLEN names eight, omitting OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC. So the join's eight is set-equal to the live ledger and the harness's ninth is the stale side — which G21 v3 anticipated in its own noteOnG12, 'A sibling G12 candidate may exist'. The join's wording is also precise: it claims only that v6 still measures the eight, which is true of v6's bytes, and it does not claim to enumerate G21 v3's list. Carrying the ninth would in fact have breached the dispatch's prohibition on taking over G12. This is the mirror of the case I ruled on at g12-leftover-join.v1, and I have ruled it the same way. The rest is clean and was measured rather than read. The join reproduces G21 v3's namedCorpusWhenFixturesExist twice and I compared both as parsed objects: the top-level copy equals the source field, the FX copy recombines to it, and the doesNotExecute sequence NT-3, NT-5, NT-4, NT-7 is reproduced in the source's own non-obvious order. Twenty distinct CC, NT and FC identifiers appear and all twenty are present in G21 v3, so none is invented. Seven obligations reconcile against seven summary entries with every flag and rideStanding agreeing with its bucket. OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING stays leftoverDesign true and alone in summary.leftoverDesign; OBL-G21-INPUT-CORPUS is false at specified-not-leftover, resting on an ACCEPT I checked against the review bytes. file08StatusToken is OPEN and file 08's DR-G21 row ends in OPEN. G21 v3's leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded is exactly ['OBL-G21-HARNESS-SPEC'] and its leftoverNameNote is absent at every depth, both as claimed. As a successor this is not a repair — v1 carries an ACCEPT at 0/0, so the absence of a findingDisposition is correct, and v2 exists because g21-input-corpus.v1 landed. The diff is targeted: six obligations to seven, one added and none removed, and the only carried-forward change is a single added sentence in OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING's reason with its flag, ride, corpus, doesNotExecute and every refusal intact. doesNot is byte-identical to v1's, so no prohibition was weakened. All three limbs of my own CLAUDE-PTLJ-V3-SF1 pattern are clean: incremented and consistent identity triples, zero predecessor self-claims, and a predecessorV1 key that actually holds v1. Disclosure: all five Claude-lane verdicts this join pins are mine, and the predecessor-identity pattern it is tested against is my own finding.
